scope: Independent review of root-authored Expedition integration: Layout, Marketplace page/hook, Hero, CollectionStrip, compileStyles extension and CSS source scoping. Own theme provider/context is excluded from independent quality assessment.

findings.finding: CTA Minha coleção links to /profile, which edits profile and does not display an owned NFT collection.
findings.recommendation: Use Meu perfil or provide a genuine collection view before claiming that feature.

conclusions: useLayout only adds themeName consumption; query keys, cart counting, logout and cache behavior remain unchanged in this diff.
useMarketplace only adds themeName to state returned to the page; search term effect stays dependent on URL search.q and no theme-driven API effect was introduced.
CollectionStrip uses valid existing category values and resets pagination to1 through the existing URL update function; no fictitious collection counts or business entities added.
Hero and CollectionStrip remain presentational, with data access and router-state actions delegated to the page hook.
Expedition CSS selectors are scoped to html[data-theme=expedition] in the four source templates reviewed; the Kurio hero branch preserves its previous composition.
compileStyles deterministically joins four explicit source files and replaces breakpoint tokens; it does not execute app services or alter demo data.
Own ThemeSwitcher accessibility defect from concurrent fix was resolved: one explicit aria-label and title per button; no duplicate JSX attributes remain.
qualityAssessment: The reviewed integration preserves the established view/hook and service boundaries. Theme selection is presentation state and does not introduce marketplace domain rules. No numeric quality score assigned.

validation.independentBrowserTests: Delegated to API reviewer; not claimed here.
validation.visualBaseline: Static preservation observed; final Kurio screenshot regressions still require consolidated tests.

limits: No claim of pixel-identical Figma fidelity.
Provider/context authored by this reviewer was not independently graded.
A separate implementation/theme-review result must be retained with this report.
publication: No publication or external submission performed by reviewer.
